$comment: Account group (auth.*, onboarding.*, groups.*, settings.*, safety.*, system.permissions, paywall) — Redesign Pass 2 on Retro (docs/REDESIGN_BRIEF.md). Only values Retro measured for these surfaces, plus the platform rules they need; everything else is a global.* token or a component of design/components.md, named in design/surfaces/<id>.md. Conflicts: design/MERGE_DECISIONS.md → 'Redesign — Account (RA-*)'.

auth.phone.fontSize.wordmark.element: the app's name set in the display serif (font.global.display) where Retro's landing shows its wordmark, centred above the tagline

auth.phone.fontSize.wordmark.notes: Only the size and role are sourced: the wordmark itself is the owner's (config/app.json displayName or a logo, BLOCKED until set). Retro's wordmark, its 3-D 'R' mark and Roslindale files are do-not-copy.

auth.phone.layout.countryCode.element: country calling-code selector inside the phone field (mechanics)
auth.phone.layout.countryCode.evidence: react-native-phone-input 1.4.1 (MIT; public npm package https://registry.npmjs.org/react-native-phone-input/-/react-native-phone-input-1.4.1.tgz, repository github.com/rili-live/react-native-phone-input; read 2026-10-16): dist/styles.js container {flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center'} with the flag first (no margin: at the container's leading edge) and flag {width: 30, height: 20}; dist/PhoneInput.js the number's view {flex: 1, marginLeft: this.props.offset || 10} (README: 'offset | int | 10 | distance between flag and phone number'); onPressFlag without a handler: picker.selectCountry(iso2) + picker.show() (the country list); README 'autoFormat | boolean | false | Format phone number while typing', 'allowZeroAfterCountryCode | bool | true'; formatting while typing is the platform's own behaviour: https://developer.android.com/reference/android/telephony/PhoneNumberFormattingTextWatcher ('Watches a TextView and if a phone number is entered will format it.')
auth.phone.layout.countryCode.method: the open-source phone-input component’s documented defaults, placed in Retro’s field: its container is the field’s content box, so the flag starts at C-12’s text inset (radius.global.field, 19); autoFormat on (the platform formats as you type)
auth.phone.layout.countryCode.notes: Replaces the gap-fill values G2-4 (flag 20 × 13, 20 leading, 5 to the text), re-sourced under owner decision 22 (2026-10-16). Colours and shape come from C-12 (Retro). Retro’s own phone form: one raw screenshot of the first sign-up step on a fresh install.

groups.list.layout.templateCovers.element: "Ideas to Get Started" template thumbnails (owner decision 9): one cover photo per group kind

groups.list.layout.templateCovers.method: every fixture photo viewed at full size; only photos with no person in them kept (no faces, no figures, no hands); among those, one per kind matching its description; no alcohol or brand marks (picnic-spread-3x4 dropped: wine bottle and glasses). Centre crop to 3:4 (road-trip-window x 270–810 of 1080; cake-chocolate-candles x 27–837 of 864; pizza-table whole frame; sunset-lake y 134–945 of 1080), Lanczos resize to 3 × size.global.rowThumbWidth × 3 × size.global.rowThumbHeight = 216 × 291 px, JPEG quality 80, sRGB, no EXIF / ICC (python3 -I + PIL)
groups.list.layout.templateCovers.notes: Drawn like a group cover: aspect-fill in the C-15 thumbnail (size.global.rowThumbWidth × rowThumbHeight, radius.global.thumbnail). Retro's own template photos and its user-styled cover titles are not copied (groups.list do-not-copy).

Closes the 'album cover drop shadow — unmeasured' entry of layout.global.elevation. Only light captures exist; on the dark page the shadow is invisible (no dark variant is sourced).

groups.invite.layout.qrCard.method: composition of Retro components C-34 (recap card shell holding the QR in its grid area), C-11 (Save circle on media) and C-09 (Share pill) in Retro's recap preview order (ST-04); encoding parameters reused from the web invite page; quiet zone per the QR Code specification's owner (DENSO WAVE); footer baselines measured on references/auto/retro/press/tc-2023-12-recaps.png phone 2 (card x 1129.5–1647.5 = 518 px, bottom edge y 1275 — first non-white row): 'retro.app' baseline (bottom of 'retro' ink) y 1242 → (1275 − 1242) ÷ 518 = 0.0637; 'nathan' baseline y 1213 → name → detail pitch (1242 − 1213) ÷ 518 = 0.056 (python3 -I + PIL, rows with ink darker than 200 / 120)
groups.invite.layout.qrCard.notes: Retro's QR card art itself was never captured (only its strings and tiny-print size), so the card is Retro's recap card holding the code, the shape Retro uses for its own share cards ('2023 / nathan / retro.app', TC-H). Not copied: Retro's domain line 'Retro.app' (owner's domain, BLOCKED) and 'Member since %1$d' (a person's join year; this card is a group's). No logo or avatar over the code's centre: the web QR's centre avatar shows who invited you on /i/ (invite.web), the card names the group instead. Error correction stays H so a printed card survives wear.
